title: Electrical Superintendent
description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE**

Since 1886, Lewis has built some of the Pacific Northwest’s most important places: hospitals, research labs, schools, and data centers. Now we’re bringing that same excellence and care to data center work in Arizona. Plus, we’re 100% employee-owned, so everyone on our team has a stake in our success and a voice in where we go next.

On a data center, the day power first hits new switchgear is the day everything has to be right. As our **Electrical Superintendent**, you make sure it is. The gear has been inspected, the sequence is planned, every crew is protected, and the client’s uptime is never at risk.

We’re hiring an **Electrical Superintendent** to run electrical field operations on data center and advanced technology projects in the Phoenix area. You’ll own the electrical side of the job in the field: power distribution, low-voltage systems, temporary power, energization, shutdowns, safety, quality, schedule, crew productivity, trade coordination, and site logistics.

You’ll be the link between the field, the project team, the client, trade partners, and commissioning agents, and the person they all count on to give it to them straight.

This role fits someone who has run large electrical scopes on data centers or other mission critical work, where uptime, safety, and sequencing aren’t negotiable. Maybe you came up through the trade, maybe through general contracting, maybe both. What matters is that you’ve done the work and led the people doing it.

You’ll be on site every day, your calls will shape how these facilities get built and energized, and as an employee-owner you’ll share in what we build.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

In your first year, here’s what we expect to see:

* Your jobsite is safe, organized, and productive. Crews know the plan, work is coordinated, and commitments get met.
